description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 19/07210, appeal ref. APP/K5600/W/20/3253655 (Redevelopment of site involving retention and restoration of front facade of building, erection of two additional storeys and alteration and extensions to rear at first and second floor levels to provide 19 residential units (3 x studios, 9 x 1 bed, 6 x 2 beds and 1 x 5 beds), creation of additional basement level to provide a gym, alteration of existing basement level to provide improved retail floorspace and provision of shop fronts. (Major Application)); to amend the wording of conditions 11 (Cycle Storage) and 19 (Refuse Storage) to allow the partial discharge of those conditions, to allow occupation in a phased manner, while ensuring the details for the residential, commercial and gym uses are submitted and approved.
